title: IT Specialist (Data Science)

requirements.text: IT related experience demonstrated by paid or unpaid experience obtained in either the private or public sector, and/or completion of specific, intensive training that demonstrates all of the following four competencies
requirements.evidence: IT related experience demonstrated by paid or unpaid experience obtained in either the private or public sector, and/or completion of specific, intensive training that demonstrates all of the following four competencies

requirements.text: you must have 1 year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-11 level in the Federal service
requirements.evidence: you must have 1 year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-11 level in the Federal service

requirements.text: collecting and generating data, including assisting with the design or use of surveys or other scientific instruments to collect data
requirements.evidence: collecting and generating data, including assisting with the design or use of surveys or other scientific instruments to collect data

requirements.text: curating and processing data, including performing quality checks on data sets and other information sources to identify and address data issues
requirements.evidence: curating and processing data, including performing quality checks on data sets and other information sources to identify and address data issues

requirements.text: preparing or supporting the dissemination of data
requirements.evidence: preparing or supporting the dissemination of data

requirements.text: identifying and resolving routine data performance and management issues
requirements.evidence: identifying and resolving routine data performance and management issues

requirements.text: storing and managing high-quality data from diverse sources for use by decision makers
requirements.evidence: storing and managing high-quality data from diverse sources for use by decision makers

requirements.text: analyzing comprehensive data sets using statistical software or programming languages (e.g., R, Python) to meet established business or program requirements
requirements.evidence: analyzing comprehensive data sets using statistical software or programming languages (e.g., R, Python) to meet established business or program requirements

uncertain: Entry level GS-12 annotated (GS-13 not counted). The tasks after 'such as' are examples of qualifying experience: annotated nice. The four competencies are part of the basic requirement: counted.
